brief:
Dr. Ramzi Khouri, member of the PLO Executive Committee and head of the Higher Presidential Committee for Church Affairs in Palestine, challenged claims made by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu during his address to the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly, IMEMC News reported.

Khouri's specific objections to Netanyahu's remarks were not detailed in available accounts of the exchange.
